https://www.jci.org/articles/view/121476#sd 
hervQuant expression matrices for TCGA pan-cancer (UQN and RPM) and aPD1-treated ccRCC (raw reads) RNA-Seq datasets are available in Supplemental Tables 12-14.
Table 12 = log2(RPM) -- HERV counts normalized to each sample's total sequencing depth
Table 13 = log2(UQN) -- HERV counts normalized to the 75th percentile of that sample's distribution

```{r load hervquant and hervdb RPM matrices}
# hervQuant Table 12: log2(RPM) HERV expression matrix
hervquant <- read.table("data/hervquant_supplemental_table12.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
hervquant$Sample_ID <- gsub("_", "-", hervquant$Sample_ID)

hervquant <- hervquant %>% t()
colnames(hervquant) <- hervquant[1, ]
hervquant <- hervquant[-1, ]
hervquant_mat <- apply(hervquant, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(hervquant_mat) <- rownames(hervquant)

# Precomputed HERVdb (Telescope) RPM matrix -- already normalized to each
# sample's total sequencing depth (genes + HERVs combined)
rpm_matrix <- read.csv("data/hervdb_tcga_rpm_matrix.csv", row.names = 1)

# HERV ID conversion table (hervdb <-> hervquant)
convert <- read.table("data/annotations/hervdb_v13_convert.bed", sep = "\t") %>% dplyr::select(V4, V8)
colnames(convert) <- c("hervquant", "hervdb")

# restrict both matrices to the samples they share, in matching column order
shared_samples <- intersect(colnames(hervquant_mat), colnames(rpm_matrix))
hervquant_mat <- hervquant_mat[, shared_samples]
rpm_matrix <- rpm_matrix[, shared_samples]

identical(colnames(hervquant_mat), colnames(rpm_matrix))  # sanity check -- should be TRUE
```

```{r pseudocount}
# log2(RPM+1), matching hervQuant's Table 12 convention (confirmed empirically: pseudocount = 1)
log2_rpm_matrix <- log2(rpm_matrix + 1)

# should now have NO negative values at all, since log2(x+1) >= 0 for x >= 0
range(log2_rpm_matrix)
sum(log2_rpm_matrix < 0)   # should be 0

convert_matched <- convert %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% rownames(log2_rpm_matrix))

message(nrow(convert_matched), " of ", nrow(convert), " conversion entries found in log2_rpm_mat")
message(length(unique(convert_matched$hervquant)), " unique hervQuant loci represented")

log2_rpm_herv <- log2_rpm_matrix[convert_matched$hervdb, , drop = FALSE]

aggregated_by_hervquant <- convert_matched %>%
  select(hervdb, hervquant) %>%
  left_join(
    log2_rpm_herv %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("hervdb"),
    by = "hervdb"
  ) %>%
  select(-hervdb) %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_rpm_plus1") %>%
  group_by(hervquant, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # un-pseudocount each sub-locus back to linear RPM, sum in linear space,
    # then re-apply the pseudocount ONCE to the summed total -- not per sub-locus
    rpm_summed = sum(2^log2_rpm_plus1 - 1),
    log2_rpm_summed = log2(rpm_summed + 1),
    n_loci = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hervdb_long <- aggregated_by_hervquant %>%
  select(hervquant, sample_id, hervdb_log2rpm = log2_rpm_summed)

hervquant_long <- hervquant_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervquant") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "hervquant_log2rpm")

concordance_data <- hervdb_long %>%
  inner_join(hervquant_long, by = c("hervquant", "sample_id"))

message(nrow(concordance_data), " matched hervquant-locus x sample observations")
message(length(unique(concordance_data$hervquant)), " unique loci in the comparison")

locus_summary <- concordance_data %>%
  group_by(hervquant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_hervdb = mean(hervdb_log2rpm),
    mean_hervquant = mean(hervquant_log2rpm),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_result <- cor.test(locus_summary$mean_hervdb, locus_summary$mean_hervquant, method = "spearman")
cor_result

p_concordance <- ggplot(locus_summary, aes(x = mean_hervquant, y = mean_hervdb)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Concordance of shared HERV loci between databases",
    subtitle = paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(cor_result$estimate, 3),
                       ", p = ", format.pval(cor_result$p.value, digits = 2)),
    x = "hervQuant mean log2(RPM+1)",
    y = "HERV-db mean log2(RPM+1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_concordance)
#ggsave("output/concordance_plot_pseudocount.pdf", height = 6, width = 8)

#### violin
vln_long <- rbind(hervdb_long, hervquant_long)
ggplot(vln_long, aes(x = dataset, y = log2rpm)) + geom_violin() +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
#ggsave("output/violin_plot_pseudocount.pdf", height = 6, width = 8)
```

```{r concordance plot with hervdb exclusive loci}
log2_rpm_matrix <- log2(rpm_matrix + 1)

convert_matched <- convert %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% rownames(log2_rpm_matrix))

log2_rpm_herv <- log2_rpm_matrix[convert_matched$hervdb, , drop = FALSE]

aggregated_by_hervquant <- convert_matched %>%
  select(hervdb, hervquant) %>%
  left_join(
    log2_rpm_herv %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("hervdb"),
    by = "hervdb"
  ) %>%
  select(-hervdb) %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_rpm_plus1") %>%
  group_by(hervquant, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    rpm_summed = sum(2^log2_rpm_plus1 - 1),
    log2_rpm_summed = log2(rpm_summed + 1),
    n_loci = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hervdb_long <- aggregated_by_hervquant %>%
  select(hervquant, sample_id, hervdb_log2rpm = log2_rpm_summed)

hervquant_long <- hervquant_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervquant") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "hervquant_log2rpm")

## ---- Shared loci for correlation ----

shared_ids <- intersect(hervdb_long$hervquant, hervquant_long$hervquant)

concordance_data <- hervdb_long %>%
  filter(hervquant %in% shared_ids) %>%
  inner_join(hervquant_long, by = c("hervquant", "sample_id"))

locus_summary <- concordance_data %>%
  group_by(hervquant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_hervdb = mean(hervdb_log2rpm),
    mean_hervquant = mean(hervquant_log2rpm),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(source = "shared")

## ---- HERVdb-exclusive loci: raw RBRT IDs never present in `convert` at all ----

all_hervdb_ids <- rownames(log2_rpm_matrix)
hervdb_only_raw_ids <- setdiff(all_hervdb_ids, convert$hervdb)

message(length(hervdb_only_raw_ids), " HERVdb loci have no crosswalk entry in `convert` at all")

locus_summary_hervdb_only <- log2_rpm_matrix[hervdb_only_raw_ids, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervquant") %>%   # keeping column name "hervquant" for rbind compatibility, even though these are raw RBRT IDs
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "hervdb_log2rpm") %>%
  group_by(hervquant) %>%
  summarise(mean_hervdb = mean(hervdb_log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(mean_hervquant = 0, source = "hervdb_only")

locus_summary_plot <- bind_rows(locus_summary, locus_summary_hervdb_only)

cor_result <- cor.test(locus_summary$mean_hervdb, locus_summary$mean_hervquant, method = "spearman")
cor_result

p_concordance <- ggplot(locus_summary_plot, aes(x = mean_hervquant, y = mean_hervdb, color = source)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(data = locus_summary, aes(x = mean_hervquant, y = mean_hervdb),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "firebrick", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("shared" = "black", "hervdb_only" = "blue"),
                      labels = c("shared" = "Shared loci", "hervdb_only" = "HERVdb-exclusive"),
                      name = "") +
  labs(
    title = "Concordance of shared HERV loci between databases",
    subtitle = paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(cor_result$estimate, 3),
                       " (shared loci only), p = ", format.pval(cor_result$p.value, digits = 2)),
    x = "hervQuant mean log2(RPM+1)",
    y = "HERV-db mean log2(RPM+1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p_concordance)
#ggsave("output/concordance_plot_pseudocount_hervdb_excl.pdf", height = 6, width = 8)
```

```{r barplots}
de_pts <- read.csv("data/results/patients_deh_results.csv")
de_tcga <- read.csv("data/results/tcga_kirc_deh.csv")

all_de <- rbind(de_pts, de_tcga) %>% group_by(idx) %>% summarize(lfc = -1 * mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE))
shared_de <- de_pts$idx[which(de_pts$idx %in% de_tcga$idx)] %>% unique()
shared_de <- c(shared_de, "RBRT190212")

conversion_sub <- convert %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% shared_de)

hervdb_long <- log2_rpm_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervdb") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervdb, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2rpm")
hervdb_long <- left_join(hervdb_long, convert)

## ---- Reshape both matrices to long format ----
hervquant_long <- hervquant_long %>% mutate(dataset = "hervquant") %>% rename(log2rpm = hervquant_log2rpm)
hervdb_long <- hervdb_long %>% mutate(dataset = "hervdb")

hervquant_long <- left_join(hervquant_long, convert)

combined_long <- bind_rows(hervquant_long, hervdb_long)
combined_long <- combined_long %>% filter(hervdb %in% shared_de)

## ---- Summarize: mean + SE per locus per dataset ----

combined_summary <- combined_long %>%
  group_by(hervdb, dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(hervdb, dataset, fill = list(mean_value = 0, se = 0))

## ---- Plot ----

ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = hervdb, y = mean_value, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(),
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("hervdb" = "blue", "hervquant" = "black")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Normalized expression (log2rpm)", fill = "", title = "hervquant vs Telescope") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

#ggsave("output/hervquant_v_telescope_bar_pseudocount.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
```

```{r different plotting attempt}
# rebuild hervquant summary fresh (one row per hervquant locus)
hervquant_raw_long <- hervquant_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervquant") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2rpm")

hervquant_summary <- hervquant_raw_long %>%
  group_by(hervquant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# rebuild hervdb summary, one row per hervdb locus, restricted to shared_de
hervdb_raw_long <- log2_rpm_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervdb") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervdb, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2rpm") %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% shared_de)

hervdb_summary <- hervdb_raw_long %>%
  group_by(hervdb) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(log2rpm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(dataset = "hervdb")

# map each hervdb to its hervquant group (if any), then pull that hervquant's
# summary value; loci with no match get 0 (and are flagged for reference)
hervdb_to_hervquant <- convert %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% shared_de) %>%
  distinct(hervdb, hervquant)

hervquant_matched <- tibble(hervdb = shared_de) %>%
  left_join(hervdb_to_hervquant, by = "hervdb") %>%
  left_join(hervquant_summary, by = "hervquant") %>%
  mutate(
    matched_in_hervquant = !is.na(hervquant),
    mean_value = if_else(is.na(mean_value), 0, mean_value),
    se = if_else(is.na(se), 0, se),
    dataset = "hervquant"
  ) %>%
  select(hervdb, mean_value, se, dataset, matched_in_hervquant)

# combine and plot, faceting/ordering by hervdb directly (no NA grouping)
plot_summary <- bind_rows(
  hervdb_summary %>% mutate(matched_in_hervquant = NA),
  hervquant_matched
)

ggplot(plot_summary, aes(x = dataset, y = mean_value, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se), width = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ hervdb, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("hervdb" = "darkviolet", "hervquant" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Normalized expression (log2 RPM)", fill = "",
       title = "HERV-db captures loci absent from or merged in hervQuant") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

#ggsave("output/hervquant_v_telescope_bar_facet.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
```

```{r back to linear -- run this after loading the RPM matrices}
### RPM-scale version of the fragmentation/coverage plot
### Run this AFTER: the RPM matrix load chunk (needs rpm_matrix, convert)
###             AND: the barplots chunk (needs shared_de, hervquant_mat)

# reverse hervQuant's log2(RPM+1) back to linear RPM, preserving true zeros
hervquant_rpm_mat <- hervquant_mat
hervquant_rpm_mat[hervquant_rpm_mat != 0] <-
  2^hervquant_rpm_mat[hervquant_rpm_mat != 0] - 1

# hervQuant summary (mean + SE) directly in RPM space, one row per locus
hervquant_raw_long_rpm <- hervquant_rpm_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervquant") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervquant, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "rpm")

hervquant_summary_rpm <- hervquant_raw_long_rpm %>%
  group_by(hervquant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(rpm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# HERV-db summary directly in RPM space (using rpm_matrix, not log2_rpm_matrix)
hervdb_raw_long_rpm <- rpm_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervdb") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervdb, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "rpm") %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% shared_de)

hervdb_summary_rpm <- hervdb_raw_long_rpm %>%
  group_by(hervdb) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(rpm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(dataset = "hervdb")

# map each hervdb locus to its hervquant group (if any); unmatched -> 0
hervdb_to_hervquant <- convert %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% shared_de) %>%
  distinct(hervdb, hervquant)

hervquant_matched_rpm <- tibble(hervdb = shared_de) %>%
  left_join(hervdb_to_hervquant, by = "hervdb") %>%
  left_join(hervquant_summary_rpm, by = "hervquant") %>%
  mutate(
    matched_in_hervquant = !is.na(hervquant),
    mean_value = if_else(is.na(mean_value), 0, mean_value),
    se = if_else(is.na(se), 0, se),
    dataset = "hervquant"
  ) %>%
  select(hervdb, mean_value, se, dataset, matched_in_hervquant)

plot_summary_rpm <- bind_rows(
  hervdb_summary_rpm %>% mutate(matched_in_hervquant = NA),
  hervquant_matched_rpm
)

ggplot(plot_summary_rpm, aes(x = dataset, y = mean_value, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se), width = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ hervdb, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("hervdb" = "darkviolet", "hervquant" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Normalized expression (RPM)", fill = "",
       title = "HERV-db captures loci absent from or merged in hervQuant") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

#ggsave("output/hervquant_v_telescope_bar_facet_linear.pdf", width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# concordance recomputed on linear RPM instead of log2, fresh + unfiltered (all loci, not just shared_de)
hervdb_all_long_rpm <- rpm_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("hervdb") %>%
  pivot_longer(-hervdb, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "rpm")

concordance_data_rpm <- hervdb_all_long_rpm %>%
  filter(hervdb %in% convert_matched$hervdb) %>%
  left_join(convert_matched, by = "hervdb") %>%
  group_by(hervquant, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(hervdb_rpm_summed = sum(rpm), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(hervquant_raw_long_rpm, by = c("hervquant", "sample_id")) %>%
  rename(hervquant_rpm = rpm)

locus_summary_rpm <- concordance_data_rpm %>%
  group_by(hervquant) %>%
  summarise(mean_hervdb = mean(hervdb_rpm_summed),
            mean_hervquant = mean(hervquant_rpm),
            .groups = "drop")

nrow(locus_summary_rpm)   # sanity check -- should be close to the full shared-locus count

p_concordance <- ggplot(locus_summary, aes(x = mean_hervquant, y = mean_hervdb)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Concordance of shared HERV loci between databases",
    subtitle = paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(cor_result_rpm$estimate, 3),

  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
```

```{r additional plots}
# concordance with hervdb-exclusive HERVs
```
